g.title: video_processor_clocks
g.text: One 33.333 MHz board clock; py_soc's clock generator makes every clock except the camera byte clock. Each lane runs from its source to the blocks it clocks and the clocks forwarded off chip. Bold = library IP module name, grey = instance name.
Domains tagged `VP_* exist only when that interface is enabled in src/configuration.sv. The resets of each domain are in reset_diagram.svg.

g.title: pll_vid
g.text: outputs phase aligned, gated by SYSCTL CLK_EN

g.title: d_cpu
g.text: · py_core, py_boot, SRAM, intc, watchdog, SYSCTL,
2× UART, 2× I2C, 2× SPI, 3× GPIO, spi_flash_ctrl; u_pll_clk loop

g.title: d_pix
g.text: read sides of u_axil_cdc (← cpu_clk), u_pipe.u_cdc, u_pipe.u_ps_* (← byte_clk)
src sides of u_irq_stats, u_irq_frame0/1 (→ cpu_clk)
parallel sides of u_tmds_ser, u_lvds_ser_a/b, dsi_tx, csi2_tx
